method: Every question from every paper in this archive is matched to one syllabus topic by keyword rules that were checked by hand. Importance = total marks the topic has carried across all papers (High = top third). Backward-looking only - not a prediction.
summary: 18 papers (2012 to Aug 2025), 288 questions. By total marks the heaviest topics are: Negotiable instruments: promissory notes and bills of exchange; Paying banker: duties and statutory protection; dishonour by bank; Banking Regulation Act and RBI; Cheques: definition, crossing and account payee. Most repeated in the papers from 2022 onwards: Negotiable instruments: promissory notes and bills of exchange (17×); Paying banker: duties and statutory protection; dishonour by bank (15×); Banker's lien, set-off and appropriation (12×); Loans, advances and securities: pledge, mortgage, shares (12×). This shows what has been asked before; it is not a prediction.
